name: product-migration-engine
description: Open-source Shopify to WooCommerce product migration utility

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
